in_sanskrit.name: अरिन्दम
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who holds or supports the king
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अरि (ari) - king or ruler दम (dam) - to hold or support

in_hindi.name: अरिन्दम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरि (ari) - राजा (raja) - king दम (dam) - वासित (vasit) - ruling Therefore, Arindam can be interpreted as 'Ruling king'

in_tamil.name: அரிந்தம்
in_tamil.meaning: அரியான் வழிபாடு (ariyan vazhipadu) - one who holds or supports the king
in_tamil.long_meaning: அரி (ari) - அரியான் (ariyan) - king இத்தம் (indam) - வழிபாடு (vazhipadu) - one who holds or supports

in_telugu.name: అరిన్దమ్
in_telugu.meaning: అరియపోదు (aripodu) - one who holds or supports
in_telugu.long_meaning: అరి (ari) - అరియపోదు (aripodu) - one who holds or supports దమ్ (dam) - దేశము (desamu) - the king

in_marathi.name: Arindam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Possession of the gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arindam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arindam is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arindamana', which means 'possessed by the gods'. In Hindu mythology, the name is given to a child believed to be chosen by the gods, often with special blessings and protection.
